explication: OpenObserve is a unified observability platform for ingesting logs, metrics, traces, RUM, and AI telemetry, then storing, compacting, querying, visualizing, and alerting on those signals. The principal workflow is: telemetry clients call HTTP/gRPC ingestion, signal handlers persist data to object storage, query execution reads and analyzes it, and the web console presents results. Management APIs configure dashboards, pipelines, alerts, and database monitoring. The tree supports these subsystems; several cross-module arrows are architectural inferences from documented capabilities rather than sampled call sites.
